# Plantify Tech (plantify.tech)

> South Africa's agricultural investment platform — invest in vetted farm projects from R100, track real agriculture with AI insights, and earn returns at harvest.

Plantify Tech is an agri-fintech platform similar in accessibility to share-investment apps: everyday people can browse farm projects, invest from as little as R100, and farmers can raise capital without traditional bank collateral requirements.

## Primary topics

- Farm investment and agricultural investment in South Africa
- Agricultural crowdfunding and crowd farming
- Agritech fintech and mobile farm investing
- Farmer funding and small-scale farmer capital
- Impact investing in agriculture and food security
- Alternative real-asset investments (crops, livestock, mixed farming)
- AI-tracked farm project performance and harvest returns

## Key pages

- Home: https://plantify.tech/
- Invest in farms: https://plantify.tech/investors
- Farm funding for farmers: https://plantify.tech/farmers
- About: https://plantify.tech/about
- Investor beta signup: https://plantify.tech/investor
- Help & FAQs: https://plantify.tech/help
- Contact: https://plantify.tech/contact

## How it works for investors

1. Browse vetted farming projects across Southern Africa
2. Invest from R100 in projects you believe in
3. Track growth with AI-powered insights
4. Receive returns aligned with harvest performance

## How it works for farmers

1. Create a verified farm profile
2. Launch a funding campaign with clear goals
3. Receive capital from investors
4. Grow the farm and share returns at harvest

## Regions served

South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Mozambique, Zimbabwe (Southern Africa focus)
